idea-plugin.name: Forge Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Live diagram preview for Forge .forge models.

Open a .forge file and the rendered diagram appears beside the source. Every view the model defines — system context, containers, pipelines, deployment, data model, trust boundaries, teams, animated walkthroughs — can be picked from the preview toolbar.

  • Updates as you type, including unsaved changes
  • Re-renders when an !included file changes
  • Zoom, fit-to-width, and a palette that follows the IDE theme
  • Model errors reported above the last good diagram instead of blanking it

Rendering is done by the forge CLI, which must be installed (brew install grahambrooks/forge/forge or cargo install). Its location can be set under Settings | Tools | Forge Preview.
